completionEnabled.title: Enable AI inline & smart completion
completionEnabled.description: Enable multi-language Cursor-style Fill-In-The-Middle ghost text and interactive AI smart code completion.

completionBackend.title: AI completion backend
completionBackend.description: Use 'openai' to call the configured OpenAI-compatible Server directly (zero setup), or 'companion' to bridge to a local 127.0.0.1 companion service.

completionModel.title: Completion model override
completionModel.description: Optional faster model specifically for inline ghost-text completion (leave empty to reuse the Server page model).

completionMaxLines.title: Max inline completion lines
completionMaxLines.description: Maximum number of lines allowed in a single AI ghost-text suggestion (1 to 64).

completionPopupEnabled.title: Enable PyCharm-style instant popup completion
completionPopupEnabled.description: Provide sub-5ms local popup completions including cached AI predictions, in-file proximity symbols, and idioms.

completionStreamChunkLines.title: Streaming lines per step
completionStreamChunkLines.description: Number of lines written per progressive streaming step when inserting AI completion into the file.

completionPostfixEnabled.title: Enable postfix template completion (.if, .for, .var, .ret, ...)
completionPostfixEnabled.description: Transform expressions after '.' into control flow, logging, error wrapping, or variable bindings.

completionAutoImportEnabled.title: Enable stdlib & ecosystem auto-import completion
completionAutoImportEnabled.description: Automatically insert missing import / use statements at the top of the file when accepting recognized symbols.

completionPort.title: Local companion service port
completionPort.description: Loopback only (127.0.0.1). Used only when backend is 'companion'. Match AI_COMPLETION_PORT in the companion environment.

completionContextBytes.title: Maximum source context bytes
completionContextBytes.description: Total UTF-8 bytes of prefix, suffix, enclosing scopes, and workspace symbols sent to the completion model.

completionRequestTimeoutMs.title: Completion request deadline (ms)
completionRequestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for inline completion requests (100 to 180000 ms).
